regions.merged_text: TRANSFIXION OF MARY * MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD. TO KNOW IS TO APPRECIATE. Next to the sorrows of Jesus and next to the inexhaustible Love of His Sacred Heart, the sorrows of Mary and the love that filled her soul, surpass comprehension. At times, in the course of the following pages, one can only wonder as at a manifest miracle, the fact that Mary survived the bit- ter Passion of Jesus. She did survive Him; more than twenty years; becoming the stay and the gentle Mistress and Mother and Queen of the Apostles and of all the faithful in the entire Infant Church; next to Jesus Himself most meek and humble, next to Him, most copassionate and gentle. Here, to know is to love. Would that Mary were better known! Would that her sorrows were appreciated! How much better then would not Jesus Himself be known! How much more loved and adored!
